illustrationStylePrompt: Style: hand-drawn wax crayon and oil pastel illustration, made on textured paper with visible grain. Rough color strokes, layered colors, uneven pressure. No clean outlines, no sharp edges, no digital smoothness. Use warm, slightly saturated colors. Flat and simple shapes. No realistic lighting or shading. The overall feeling should be calm, friendly, and human, like a children’s picture book or editorial illustration. Avoid: digital illustration, clean line art, vector style, watercolor, oil painting, 3D render, realistic shading, smooth gradients, anime, cartoon style, ink outlines
